verdict.rationale: Supabase provides the building blocks for background automation — Cron for scheduled Postgres jobs, Queues (pgmq) for durable async processing, Database Webhooks to trigger external systems on events, and Edge Functions for serverless execution — which an AI-native developer can wire together to run autonomous background tasks, and the MCP server/agent-skills catalog lets an AI agent discover and invoke these primitives. However, this is composable infrastructure rather than a turnkey 'set up an autonomous agent automation' feature; there's no first-party orchestration layer for agent-triggered recurring workflows, and no independent evidence of an AI agent successfully running unattended background automations end-to-end. Missing for 10: a dedicated AI-agent automation/orchestration feature (not just generic Cron/Queues/Webhooks primitives), and independent/hands-on evidence of autonomous background agent runs.
